tools.name: dialmycalls_get_account
tools.description: Get the account: credits available (calls and texts spend credits) and the account creation date.

tools.name: dialmycalls_list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts in the account (name, phone, email, groups), 100 per page.

tools.name: dialmycalls_list_contacts_in_group
tools.description: List the contacts that belong to one contact group (from dialmycalls_list_groups), 100 per page.

tools.name: dialmycalls_get_contact
tools.description: Get one contact by id.

tools.name: dialmycalls_create_contact
tools.description: Add a contact (phone number required) to the contact list, optionally into contact groups. Sends nothing to the contact.

tools.name: dialmycalls_update_contact
tools.description: Update a contact. DialMyCalls requires the phone number on every update. Fields you omit are left as they are; if you pass group_ids the contact's groups are REPLACED by that list.

tools.name: dialmycalls_list_groups
tools.description: List contact groups with their contact counts, 100 per page.

tools.name: dialmycalls_get_group
tools.description: Get one contact group (name, contacts_count) by id.

tools.name: dialmycalls_create_group
tools.description: Create an empty contact group. Sends nothing.

tools.name: dialmycalls_list_recordings
tools.description: List voice recordings (the messages a call broadcast can play): id, name, type, length, processed. A call needs a processed recording.

tools.name: dialmycalls_get_recording
tools.description: Get one voice recording by id (includes its audio file url and whether it is processed and ready).

tools.name: dialmycalls_create_recording_tts
tools.description: Create a voice recording from text (text-to-speech) that a call broadcast can then play. Makes no call and sends nothing.

tools.name: dialmycalls_list_caller_ids
tools.description: List caller ID phone numbers on the account (id, name, phone, approved). A call broadcast needs an approved caller ID.

tools.name: dialmycalls_list_keywords
tools.description: List text-message keywords (id, keyword, status). A text broadcast must be tied to one active keyword.

tools.name: dialmycalls_list_shortcodes
tools.description: List shortcodes available to send texts from.

tools.name: dialmycalls_list_do_not_contacts
tools.description: List phone numbers on the account's do-not-contact lists (type call or text); these opted out.

tools.name: dialmycalls_list_calls
tools.description: List voice call broadcasts (name, recording, recipients, credit cost, send time), 100 per page.

tools.name: dialmycalls_get_call
tools.description: Get one voice call broadcast by id (name, recipients, credit cost, send time, pending_cancel).

tools.name: dialmycalls_list_call_recipients
tools.description: List the recipients of a call broadcast with the result per number (answered, voicemail, busy, no answer...), 100 per page.

tools.name: dialmycalls_send_call
tools.description: Send (or schedule) an automated VOICE CALL broadcast that plays a recording to real people. THIS SPENDS ACCOUNT CREDITS AND PHONES THE RECIPIENTS; it cannot be undone once it goes out (a scheduled one can be stopped with dialmycalls_cancel_call). Needs an approved caller_id (dialmycalls_list_caller_

tools.name: dialmycalls_cancel_call
tools.description: Cancel an outgoing or scheduled call broadcast that has not finished. Calls already placed are not undone.

tools.name: dialmycalls_list_texts
tools.description: List outgoing text (SMS) broadcasts (name, recipients, credit cost, send time), 100 per page.

tools.name: dialmycalls_get_text
tools.description: Get one outgoing text broadcast by id (name, recipients, credit cost, send time, pending_cancel).

tools.name: dialmycalls_list_text_recipients
tools.description: List the recipients of a text broadcast with the delivery status per number (delivered, undeliverable, queued...), 100 per page.

tools.name: dialmycalls_send_text
tools.description: Send (or schedule) a TEXT MESSAGE (SMS) broadcast to real people. THIS SPENDS ACCOUNT CREDITS AND TEXTS THE RECIPIENTS; it cannot be undone once it goes out (a scheduled one can be stopped with dialmycalls_cancel_text). Needs an active keyword (dialmycalls_list_keywords). Up to 10 messages per broad

tools.name: dialmycalls_cancel_text
tools.description: Cancel an outgoing or scheduled text broadcast that has not finished. Texts already sent are not undone.

tools.name: dialmycalls_list_incoming_texts
tools.description: List text messages people sent to the account's numbers (from, to, message, time), 100 per page.

tools.name: dialmycalls_get_incoming_text
tools.description: Get one incoming text message by id.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: dialmycalls_list_contacts, dialmycalls_list_recordings, dialmycalls_get_recording, dialmycalls_list_keywords, dialmycalls_list_incoming_texts, dialmycalls_get_incoming_text · Private data: dialmycalls_list_contacts, dialmycalls_list_contacts_in_group, dialmycalls_get_contact, dialmycalls_create_contact, dialmycalls_update_contact, dialmycalls_list_groups, dialmycalls_get_group, dialmycalls_create_group, dialmycalls_get_recording, dialmycalls_list_do_not_contacts · Public sink: dialmycalls_list_contacts, dialmycalls_list_recordings, dialmycalls_create_recording_tts, dialmycalls_list_caller_ids, dialmycalls_list_keywords, dialmycalls_list_shortcodes, dialmycalls_list_calls, dialmycalls_get_call, dialmycalls_list_call_recipients, dialmycalls_send_call, dialmycalls_cancel_call, dialmycalls_list_texts, dialmycalls_get_text, dialmycalls_list_text_recipients, dialmycalls_send_text, dialmycalls_cancel_text.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: dialmycalls_list_contacts, dialmycalls_list_recordings, dialmycalls_get_recording, dialmycalls_list_keywords, dialmycalls_list_incoming_texts, dialmycalls_get_incoming_text · Private data: dialmycalls_list_contacts, dialmycalls_list_contacts_in_group, dialmycalls_get_contact, dialmycalls_create_contact, dialmycalls_update_contact, dialmycalls_list_groups, dialmycalls_get_group, dialmycalls_create_group, dialmycalls_get_recording, dialmycalls_list_do_not_contacts · Public sink: dialmycalls_list_contacts, dialmycalls_list_recordings, dialmycalls_create_recording_tts, dialmycalls_list_caller_ids, dialmycalls_list_keywords, dialmycalls_list_shortcodes, dialmycalls_list_calls, dialmycalls_get_call, dialmycalls_list_call_recipients, dialmycalls_send_call, dialmycalls_cancel_call, dialmycalls_list_texts, dialmycalls_get_text, dialmycalls_list_text_recipients, dialmycalls_send_text, dialmycalls_cancel_text

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
